# Frozen native export, not fresh CAD evidence

These fixtures are unmodified KiCad 9.0.2 XML/CSV exports from the K1 header
migration on 2026-09-30. XML is compressed with gzip only for size. They support
ordinary parser/topology tests; historical paths/timestamps are not a new
validation run. The native gate re-exports each tested checkout and compares its
complete parsed graph with this fixture. No fixture authorizes hardware use.

## K1 current capture

Only J_DIG/J_INPUT Value and MPN differ from the previous parsed graph:
`TSW-110-07-T-D` -> `HTSW-110-07-T-D`. All nets, pin types/functions, footprints,
other properties and 67 other component records are unchanged. The CSV remains
69 rows, including eight DNP packages and the off-board controller. Both outputs
were generated by the actual native CLI and checked with the existing validators,
not edited into an invented export. See `docs/REV_A_CONNECTOR_K1.md`.
